title: Conjunctions and connecting words
descriptionFa: کلمه‌های کوچیک ولی مهمی که دو بخش جمله رو به هم وصل می‌کنن.

words.example: Sara is a student and she works part-time in a café.
They are rich, but they aren't happy.
Would you like tea or coffee?
We went home early because we were tired.
words.tipFa: دلیل رو می‌گه: چرا اتفاق افتاد.

words.example: I felt ill, so I didn't go to work.
words.tipFa: نتیجه رو می‌گه. because برعکسشه: I didn't go to work because I felt ill.

words.example: Call me when you get home.
We left before it started to rain.
We went for a meal after we saw the film.
You can have ice cream if you eat your dinner.
He only sleeps for five hours every night.

words.tipFa: like فعل هم هست یعنی «دوست داشتن».

words.example: My brother is taller than me.
words.tipFa: بعد از صفت مقایسه‌ای: bigger than, better than. با then (بعد) قاطی نشه.

words.example: I love swimming, and my brother loves it too.
words.tipFa: as well هم آخر جمله میاد. also قبل از فعل: She also works in the shop.

gapQuestions.sentence: I was hungry, ___ I made a sandwich.
I didn't go to the party ___ I was ill.
You can pay by card ___ in cash.
I'd like to come, ___ I have too much work.
___ it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
I speak English, and my sister speaks it ___.
I have ___ five minutes. Please be quick.
